mechanism: Posaconazole inhibits CYP3A4, increasing betamethasone metabolism inhibition and systemic corticosteroid exposure, while betamethasone may increase posaconazole metabolism via CYP3A4 induction.
action: Monitor for signs of corticosteroid excess (hyperglycemia, hypertension, immunosuppression); consider dose adjustment of betamethasone or alternative antifungal if prolonged therapy required.
